operations.description: Get information about groov View. No authorization required.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] groov info [PATH] info [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] groov info

operations.description: List devices available in the data store. Authorized for admins and editors.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list devices [PATH] data store devices [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] data device store

operations.description: List tags of the given device. Authorized for admins and editors.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list device tags [PATH] data store devices tags [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] definition tag

operations.description: Read the current value of a single tag. Authorized for admins and editors.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] read tag [PATH] data store read [PARAMS] count id index [SCHEMA] tag value

operations.description: List all data store tags defined in the project. Authorized for admins and editors.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list all tags [PATH] data store tags [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] definition tag

operations.description: Downloads the complete groov View log in JSON format. Added in groov View R4.2a.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] download log json [PATH] logging groov logs json [PARAMS] filter last level log minimum timestamp [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Downloads the complete groov View log. Added in groov View R4.2a.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] download log text [PATH] logging groov logs txt [PARAMS] filter last level log minimum timestamp [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get information about the user you are authenticated as. Authorized for admins, editors, operators, and kiosk.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] who am i [PATH] whoami [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] user

operations.description: Read selected tags from the data store. Authorized for admins and editors.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] batch read tags [PATH] data store read [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] tag value

operations.description: Writes a new value to the given tag. Authorized for admins and editors.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] write tag [PATH] data store write [PARAMS] id index value [SCHEMA] tag value
